author: /root/protection_atomic
conclusion: The additive template confines one public macOS NSFileManager Complete setter to fixed, pre-observed created/none.bin. Canonical root/parent and full seven-field target identity bracket the operation; target is owner-matched, single-link regular and at most 256 bytes. A successful, closed pre-sample precedes mutation. Actual BOOL and bounded NSError fields are retained before post-call guards. Setter IMP/main images and the after-sample are checked; the self-only 25-second alarm starts before autoreleasepool and output is capped at 256 KiB. No production storage, original strict predicate or five-target read-only comparison is changed. Collection PASS is independent of setter success and protection qualification.
integration_limits: Current source/control/nonce and target identities come from compiled OwnedProbeContext.h and OwnedHostReadContext.h. Separately reviewed driver controls must bind those headers and binary to the current run, require completion of the unchanged five-target read-only comparison first, and enforce a single invocation. The native template explicitly does not prove prior execution order.
Canonical root/parent/target checks are bracketing observations, not an atomic filesystem lock; safety also relies on the driver-owned private fixture tree and exclusive lifecycle.
This is source approval only, not native compilation/execution, timeout-cause proof, successful protection mutation, cleanup approval or any strict/application qualification waiver.
activity: Persists the already-completed independent review. No further audit, rechecks, tests, builds or network activity performed for this receipt.
